RSR2History.packedForest_fused_budget
  {n t r lowerCost upperCost finishCost lowerMax partitionCost fusionSaving terminalSaving : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r)
  (hrt : r < t) (htn : t ≤ n) (hlower : lowerCost ≤ lowerMax + (2 * n - 1) * (n - t))
  (hupper : upperCost + fusionSaving ≤ 2 * t - r + (t - r).choose 2 + n * (2 * t - r - 2))
  (hfinish : finishCost + terminalSaving ≤ n * (n - 1) - (n - r) ^ 2) (hpartition : 2 * (n - r) - 1 ≤ partitionCost) :
  lowerCost + upperCost + finishCost + fusionSaving + terminalSaving + (r - 1).choose 2 + 3 * (n - t) +
        ((n - r).choose 2 - (t - r).choose 2) +
      (2 * n - 3) ≤
    partitionCost + lowerMax + RSR2History.packedUpperBudget n n + (n - 1)

  (ht : 2 ≤ t) (htn : t < n) (hlower : lowerCost ≤ lowerMax + (2 * n - 1) * (n - t))
  (hupper : upperCost + phaseSaving ≤ t + n * (t - 1)) (hfinish : finishCost ≤ n * (n - 1) - (n - t) ^ 2)
  (hpartition : 2 * (n - t) - 1 ≤ partitionCost) :

    partitionCost + lowerMax + RSR2History.packedUpperBudget n n + (n - 1)
